items.text: Hey guys,

We are excited to bring you a big new update this March. Two new content will be added. The much-anticipated arrival of a brand new character is finally here along with a bigger and more interactive map.
It will also be a good time for you to jump back into HAL and resume your journey to get to the top spots in the leaderboard as Season 3 will kick off at the same time.
Let’s take a look at the update content in more detail.

Geon-Hoon, A formidable melee character who wields a giant heavy sword joins the roster. He is the half brother of Geon Hong. They haven’t gotten along well since childhood because of an incident that separated them apart which explains why there’s not much resemblance except the name.

Unlike his half-brother, he’s a ferocious warrior who finishes any enemy he sets his eye on. His skills focus on closing the distance and finishing his enemy with a powerful blow. He’s a pressure fighter whose key to victory is to maintain a distance that works to his favor. He comes with the Awoken Evil Within skin which matches his personality and combat style.
Battle Royale Map will be changed into a bigger, and more interactive map. Some of the interactive props include destructible boxes, grounds destrutible with a bomb, sliding doors, and lava zone.

There will be more confined dungeon style areas, one of which lies in the center of the map. The number of general monsters will be reduced. Instead, players will get to fight more boss monsters while there will be more buff chests and crystals to farm. All these environmental changes will have you approach the game with a different strategy.
New Season begins with lots of rewards to high-ranked players for all game modes, including Battle Royale Solo, Trio, Tag Match and Conquest.
This new update will bring new excitement to the game. We hope to see you guys in the game!

items.text: Hey guys,
Thank you for waiting. Here is the patch note for the 1.14 update which brings you a new game mode Conquest along with Pet System and brand new character effects.
More updates and events are coming in the future as well, so please stay tuned!
In Conquest Mode, three players team up to play against another team to gain control of three points for victory.
Conquest Mode takes place in one of 8 spots of the Battle Royale map. It will be randomly chosen for each game. Here are the 8 spots.
The Temple in the North of Ancient Altar
The Fortress in the South of Ancient Altar
Plundered Legacy
Abandoned Village
Fanatic Ruins
Snake Path Shrine
Tomb of Swords
Sealed Fortress
As the barrier disappears, the game starts.

Each team starts with 1,000 points, and your score decreases every second if the enemy team gains control of a control point. ( Each of the three control points decreases a different value per second.)
If you die, you will be revived at the starting area after 10 seconds.
Your job is to conquer and protect control points at all costs while trying to stay alive.
Each character starts with the same fixed stats without any consumable items. The outcome depends purely on your skills and strategies.
The team whose score drops to 0 loses.
If 10 minutes have passed, the one with a higher score wins.

notes.title: Here are other elements that will impact the outcome of the game.

items.text: Treasure Goblin: Killing a treasure goblin regains a certain points of your team’s score. Treasure goblin is summoned about five minutes after the game begins.
Boss: A boss is summoned in a random spot. Killing a boss makes your enemy team’s score decrease drastically. A boss is summoned about 8 minutes after the game begins.
You can now gain Energy when you kill a monster in Solo or Trio Battle Royale Mode.
You can check how much Energy you have absorbed at the result window.
Up to 50 Energy can be absorbed in a single game.
We now have pets in Hunter’s Arena. You can bring a pet to your Solo or Trio Battle Royale game, who will pick up items for you.
There are three different tiers of pets, High, Mid, and Low. Your pet’s tier impacts how wide they search for items and how close they follow you.
Pets can be purchased with either SP or Energy.
We have a plan to add boss characters as pets in the future update, so stay tuned for that as well.
New character effects are added which can be equipped for your character’s eye, arms, or legs.
Hope you had a good time playing Season 2.
Season 3 is coming soon which will include Conquest Mode.
In the meantime, we will have a pre-season period.
As soon as we are ready for Season 3, we will give you a heads-up.
With the start of Season 3, a tournament for Conquest Mode will be held as well.
Use this pre-season period to master your skills and prepare for the tourney.
That’s it for this patch note. Thank you for the read and your continuous support.
We will continue our best efforts to make Hunter’s Arena a better game.

For those of you who saw Hunter’s Arena showcased in PlayStation’s State of play, we are very close to having you slay demons and fight other Hunters again.

Greetings, Hunters!
Since the second Hunter's Arena: Legends CBT is just around the corner, we would like to share how the game has improved since the last test.
1. Added combat system tutorial
: As soon as you enter the game, a Combat Tutorial will be provided to help you understand the Hunter's Arena combat system.
: You can always choose to play Tutorial again in the main menu.
2. Added A.I. to the training grounds
: You can practice combat against A.I.
: A.I. has 3 difficulties. You can select any difficulty you want.
3. Added a game guide
: While playing Battle Royale mode, you will notice a lot of helpful in-game tips popping up, depending on the situation.
: You can choose to disable this function through the “Display Tips” menu in the options.
4. Added Controls Guide
: You can disable/enable Controls Guide UI by pressing the “Y” key.
A lot of players had a hard time getting used to the game during the last test. The game indeed is not easy to master, so we realized we need to do something about it.
To adapt to the game as quickly as possible, we have made a Combat Tutorial. We are still working on a Battle Royale guide, so, unfortunately, it won’t be included in this Beta.
In the future, we will continue to provide guidance to the new Hunter's Arena players.
1. Sneak attack
: Sneak Attack is activated after remaining in the bush for a certain period of time. (The character with the Sneak attack buff is not visible to other characters)
: If you engage in a PvP fight during the duration of the buff, the first attack's damage will be increased.
2. Adjusted stamina consumption while blocking
: Stamina consumption while blocking basic attacks (left mouse click) has been decreased.
: Stamina consumption while blocking skill attacks (1-5 keybinds) has been increased.
3. Infinite CC (crowd control) chain removed.
: Prevented infinite CC combos by improving the defender's recovery speed.
After monitoring the players’ strategies during the last test, we noticed that most people didn’t utilize the Sneak Attack.
We are hoping this will change with the improvement we’ve made to the Sneak Attack system.
We will continue to monitor user tendencies to correctly adjust the game balance.
1. New character added - Gyeonjo
: Gyeonjo is a beast melee tank character that is extremely effective in neutralizing single targets.
2. Basic gestures added.
: Simple communication can now be done through basic gestures.
We will continue creating different characters.
Prepare to meet new characters in the near future!
1. The overall damage balance of all the characters has been adjusted.
2. Game balance adjustments
: Adjusted the shrinking speed of the barrier
: Significantly reduced barrier damage
: The first stage of the barrier is activated at the start of the game
: Reduced fall damage
: Added experience gain when killing someone in PvP (Kilbuff is still applied as before)
: Resurrection time/cost reduced. 100% of HP is now recovered once resurrected.
: Increased attack power and experience gain when entering the Purple Zone.

After the last test, we received a lot of feedback about character balance. Our decision was to nerf Jun and Mumyung. Other characters will also receive changes to match the overall balance of the game.
We will continue to utilize our users' feedback to improve the game's balance.
1. Game Optimization
: Game Client Optimization
: Improved server latency
2. Graphics improvements
: Improved Character rendering
: Improved Graphics Rendering
: Improved environmental change effects
The most feedback we received during the last test was about optimization of the game. I would like to apologize to all of the game testers for playing in rather uncomfortable conditions.
Although there was a very brief period between first and second CBT, we focused all of our resources on creating a better optimization.
We will continue to analyze players’ feedback to create a game enjoyable for everyone.
We hope to meet you in Hunter's Arena on April 22.
